title: Jake Barber's book Sentinels of Ether partly redacted

tellings.quote: Jake Barber wrote a book called Sentinels of Ether and he came out with the first chapter of the book and it was 20 pages. Seven pages of that book were redacted by subject matter experts for some reason
the Pentagon censored seven pages of redactions this sentinels of ether book that Jake Barber put out
tellings.difference: Credits Alva Douglas as well and says outright that the Pentagon censored it.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Jake Barber's book Sentinels of Ether had seven pages redacted by the Pentagon or its reviewers.

as_told.title: Sentinels of Ether book, with seven pages redacted by the Pentagon

plain: A man named Jake Barber released the first chapter of his book Sentinels of Ether, about 20 pages long, and seven of those pages had been blacked out by subject matter experts before release. Michels tells this himself in two episodes; in the later one he says plainly that the Pentagon censored it and also mentions a person named Alva Douglas in connection with the book. He raises it because, if true, the government would be guarding whatever Barber was trying to say.
